lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid-like formation across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal spot rows, creating nodes of maximum luminance at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features running across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Four elongated, high-luminance linear features trailing from the posterior margin and ventral surface of the visible pectoral fin.
